valid_until: Evidence paths or attribute scope changes, then recheck
policy_precedent: Existing .gitattributes V1 release byte-pinned CRLF records
rules: Root V1.7 *.json -text keeps raw CRLF, normal EOF checks and actual whitespace checks.
Only reference/go-source7-native-authcore-*.py.txt -text preserves historical EOFblanklines, while CR/trailing-space/space-before-tab are distinguished.
